versions.content: function Process [SWS_DM_01968] Upstream: RS_Diag_04251 virtual ara::core::Future < void > Process ( std::uint16_t certificate EvaluationId, ara::core::Span < ara::core::Byte const > certificate Data, const MetaInfo &metaInfo, CancellationHandler cancellation Handler) noexcept=0; This method is used to process certificates send by a diagnostic tester, via the UDS subfunction TransmitCertificate inside the application. There is no specific semantics for the certificate and it is left to the application to process the received certificate and derive the needed actions. Returns true in case, the current conversation has been cancelled and false otherwise. • Register a notifier function by calling cancellationHandler.SetNotifier. The registered notifier is called if the current conversation is cancelled.
